description: Land Title Settlement Department - Rideekotaliyagama, Mahiyanganaya D/S Division, Badulla District - Cad. Map No. 710076
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains a declaration by the Commissioner of Title Settlement regarding the determination of title to specific land parcels (Parcels 4, 9, 52, 61) in Rideekotaliyagama village, including details about ownership (all parcels owned by The State), extent, class of title, and encumbrances (access road). This fits perfectly within the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it concerns land registrations, property ownership, and land title matters.
